interpretation.boundary: production run_session plus real child stdio; excludes outer installed CLI ingress/bootstrap
interpretation.exclusive: subtracts instrumented same-thread children; residual work is not an isolated phase
interpretation.human: synthetic inline callback delay; no actual human latency
interpretation.memory: worker/child process tree sampled at 10ms; peaks are lower bounds; RSS includes shared pages
interpretation.phase_rows: nested wall/thread CPU; inclusive phases overlap and must not be summed
